ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #8
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 40
   C. 10
   D. 400

2. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 60
   B. 38
   C. 30
   D. 19

3. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 170
   C. 26
   D. 169

4. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 1000 m²
   B. 10 000 m²
   C. 100 000 m²
   D. 100 m²

5. What is √36? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 7
   C. 36
   D. 6

6. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 43
   D. 1

7. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 82
   C. 81
   D. 18

8. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 8 cm and 15 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 17
   C. 19
   D. 7

9. Solve for x: x + 7 = 15. (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 15
   C. 9
   D. 7

10. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 24
   C. 12
   D. 42

11. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 25
   D. 1

12. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 49
   C. 50
   D. 7

13. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 0
   C. 8
   D. 16

14. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 36
   C. 18
   D. 90

15. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 37
   C. 2
   D. 1

16. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 22
   C. 122
   D. 121

17. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 10
   C. 24
   D. 25

18. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

19. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 15
   C. 22
   D. 44

20. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 72
   B. 1
   C. 17
   D. 73

21. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 10
   C. 400
   D. 40

22. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 156
   C. 144
   D. 48

23. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x = 5
   B. x > 5
   C. x < 5
   D. x ≥ 0 only

24. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 5
   C. 25
   D. 26

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
25. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

26. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

31. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
